name: Harrin
description: Harrin was a planet located in the Inner Rim sector of the same name. It was situated on the Corellian Trade Spine super-hyperroute and served as the endpoint of the Harrin Trade Corridor hyperlane.
lead_paragraphs: Harrin was a planet located in the Inner Rim sector of the same name. It was situated on the Corellian Trade Spine super-hyperroute and served as the endpoint of the Harrin Trade Corridor hyperlane.

Harrin was a member of the Galactic Republic since approximately 12,000 BBY; however, it was aligned with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. By 17 BBY, Harrin was a member world of the Galactic Empire.
